description: Latent schema mismatch in the (unwired) completion poll: buildSubmittedPatch stores the GMO reference embedded inside the notes STRING ('submitted;provider=...;ref=G1', bank-payout-watcher.mjs:31-34) and markPaid persists only { status, notes } (bank-payout-watcher.mjs:100-101). There is NO 'ref' column. pollCompletions, however, reads row.ref directly (bank-payout-watcher.mjs:70: queryStatus(row.ref)) and no readSubmitted implementation that parses ref out of notes exists. So even if FIND-D were wired, queryStatus would receive undefined for every row and never match 'completed'/'failed', leaving all rows 'pending' forever. The poll cannot function against the data the writer actually persists.

evidence.snippet:
notes: `submitted;provider=${info.provider};...${ref}`  // ref lives in the notes string
... const st = await queryStatus(row.ref);  // expects a row.ref field that is never written as a column
